# Copilot instructions

Follow the repository working agreement in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. Read that file before making changes; it is the single source of truth and this file only points at it.

At the start of every session, follow its required reading procedure: read
`docs/quality-gates/agent-lessons.md` completely, then `internal/agent-notes.md` if present.
Report the relevant lessons briefly before task-specific work.
